note: Ceilings for tests/test_agent_day.py (AD1). tool_calls and bytes_received count every MCP call each role makes in one run of the day and the UTF-8 bytes of every answer's text; sizes are the tool listing per profile (json.dumps of each tool's model_dump, default separators, as docs/plans/reports/agent-day-2026-11-26.md measured them), the server instructions, and three answers re-encoded as compact JSON: Sol's first full desk, the full work context of the issue Sol holds, and the brief work context of the slice. All are the measured values, identical over three runs, with no headroom. A requirement of docs/plans/AGENT_DAY_SPEC.md that removes calls or bytes lowers them in the same commit; raise one only with a stated reason in the same PR. The scripted seat makes 22 calls where the report's hand-driven session made 37: the script never mistypes an argument shape or re-reads the desk to look around. AD8 lowered the seat's tool_calls by 2 (22 to 20) and bytes_received by 156: the packet of an issue the seat holds carries your_lease with its generation, so the two get_issue_lease reads made only for it are gone. It raised work_context_full_bytes by 175 (6,980 to 7,155) and work_context_brief_bytes by 120 (1,204 to 1,324): the your_lease block itself, and the longer next_operation that names renew, complete and yield. AD6 lowered the seat's tool_calls by 1 (20 to 19) and bytes_received by 28: the open handoff Sol reclaims carries the conductor's reply, so the list_issue_comments read made to find it is gone. AD7 lowered the seat's tool_calls by 1 (19 to 18) and raised its bytes_received by 111: the slice's packets carry the outcome's goal and success criteria under work_order.inherited, so the get_issue read of the parent made to find them is gone; the two packets of the slice carry the inherited text (brief +356, 1,324 to 1,680). AD10 raised the seat's bytes_received by 80 (30,534 to 30,614), the conductor's by 97 (12,530 to 12,627) and desk_full_bytes by 80 (7,405 to 7,485): the desk identity carries last_run, the run to continue, so a seat that restarts its MCP process can stay on one run. AD3 lowered the three listing sizes (from 50,540, 62,758 and 67,165 to 33,873, 43,077 and 46,108): the listing drops pydantic's schema titles and the docstrings' source indentation, and descriptions keep what decides a call, with protocol prose left to the server instructions and the recipes they name; test_ad3_each_profiles_listing_is_within_its_target holds the specification's targets. AD10, AD11, AD12 and AD13's MCP halves raised the listings by what they add, kept under the targets by dropping "default": null from every listed schema (an omitted optional argument is already null): begin_run joins seat, list_spaces seat+knowledge, list_projects and list_fleet_seats conductor; complete_claim takes close_status and list_notifications group. Seat 33,873 to 33,916, seat+knowledge 43,077 to 43,455, conductor 46,108 to 47,133. AD2 lowered the seat's bytes_received by 8,658 (30,614 to 21,956), the conductor's by 7,312 (12,627 to 5,315), desk_full_bytes by 4,231 (7,485 to 3,254), work_context_full_bytes by 2,422 (7,155 to 4,733) and work_context_brief_bytes by 85 (1,680 to 1,595) with the same calls: my_desk and get_issue_work_context answer lean on MCP, without the fixed explanations athena://answers/glossary now holds once and without null-valued keys.
